title: Core meals provenance mutation
description: Add CookbookCore support for appending an idempotent provenance bullet under a top-of-file `## Meals` section while preserving surrounding text shape.
acceptance_criteria: `ShoppingList.appendMealsBullet(_:)` exists in CookbookCore and is public.
The mutation creates `## Meals` after the H1 when missing, or at the top when no H1 exists.
The mutation appends within an existing `## Meals` section and is idempotent for identical bullet text.
